name: Landfall
intro: Welcome to Emberholm, traveller. You came on the morning boat with nothing but your boots, I see. Lanternwick looks after its own - come and speak with me by the well.

steps.text: Speak with Reeve Hollis by the well in Lanternwick

outro: Good. Every Emberholmer starts with a patch of earth. Here's a scarecrow to mark yours, and seeds to put in it.
